title: The Sharp Cipher
author: Coral Nakamura
blurb: Yara Okonkwo, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
